svg.title: Orthogonal light-sheet microscope — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A real focusing meridian illuminates a fluorescent sample from the side while an orthogonal objective and tube lens collect its emitted signal above. The illumination lens represents a cylindrical powered section. Native rays demonstrate an orthogonal illumination/detection section. The second transverse axis, actual sheet extent and thickness, diffraction-limited sectioning and volumetric reconstruction are not available in this 2D scene.
